summary.text: Siobhan McIntyre is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 79 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described a background as a volunteer EMT and Boston 911 dispatcher and said she is a 4-H leader.

paragraphs.text: Siobhan McIntyre was born in New Jersey and graduated from the Academy of the Holy Angels.
She attended the National University of Ireland Galway and earned a bachelor's degree from Manhattanville College in 2005.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as customer service.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, McIntyre said she began as a volunteer EMT and became a 911 dispatcher in Boston, and that she later moved to Kansas to be closer to family.
She said she leads a 4-H dog project, and listed community first, advocacy for rural Kansas and bipartisan solutions on property taxes, health care access and schools as her key messages.
